heading.title: Consequences of Marriage Under This Act

article.title: 1 [Special provision in certain cases.
article.content: Where the marriage is solemnized under this Act of any person who professes the Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh or Jaina religion with a person who professes the Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh or Jaina religion, section 19 and section 21 shall not apply and so much of section 20 as creates a disability shall also not apply.]
article.html:
21A1[Special provision in certain cases.

Section 21A · Chapter IV · page 11 of the Act

Where the marriage is solemnized under this Act of any person who professes the Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh or Jaina religion with a person who professes the Hindu, Buddhist, Sikh or Jaina religion, section 19 and section 21 shall not apply and so much of section 20 as creates a disability shall also not apply.]

1 Ins. by Act 68 of 1976, s. 22 (w.e.f. 27-5-1976).
